{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_rows = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999

# Drop these rows from the dataset
df_cleaned = trial_df.drop(trial_df[sentinel_rows].index)

# Check the distribution of arm and severity in the cleaned dataset
df_cleaned.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)"}
